pageTitle: Klacks as Planning Engine for Consultants and System Integrators
hero.title: Klacks as Planning Engine for Your Clients
hero.subtitle: Open-source workforce planning with AI assistant. On-premise, 6 industry templates, 25 languages, 30 countries — and the ability to configure any industry individually with Klacksy.
customIndustries.title: Custom Industries — Klacksy Configures Your Own Industry
customIndustries.text: Beyond the six predefined industry profiles (Homecare, Healthcare, Security, Facility, Logistics, Hospitality), you can use Klacksy to create your very own planning environment. Klacksy interactively guides you through the "Planning Profile Setup" flow:
customIndustries.items.0.title: Define 29+ Rule Parameters
customIndustries.items.0.text: Working hours, rest periods, overtime, night work, public holidays, contract limits, qualification requirements
customIndustries.items.1.title: Custom Qualification Catalogues
customIndustries.items.1.text: e.g. care worker certifications, security licences (SIA), C/CE driving licence, food safety certificates, glazing master craftsman
customIndustries.items.2.title: Industry-Specific Compliance
customIndustries.items.2.text: 45h/50h weekly limits, 11h rest period, night surcharges from the 25th night, cantonal/municipal holiday calendars
customIndustries.items.3.title: Ready to Use Immediately
customIndustries.items.3.text: The system sets ACTIVE_INDUSTRIES=custom and copies a base template — no programming required, purely through Klacksy dialogue
customIndustries.cta: The result: a tailor-made planning engine for your specific industry — no programming required, purely through Klacksy dialogue.
benefits.title: Why for Consultants and System Integrators?
benefits.items.0.title: Data Sovereignty
benefits.items.0.text: Runs on the client's premises, no cloud dependency. All personnel data remains in their own infrastructure — compliant with data protection regulations.
benefits.items.1.title: AI Choice Freedom
benefits.items.1.text: 7 providers active, admin chooses — no vendor lock-in. Klacksy plans via voice input, optimises routes, enforces compliance.
benefits.items.2.title: White-Label Capable
benefits.items.2.text: MIT licence, on-premise. You host at the client, manage the instance, scale across multiple tenants.
integration.title: Integration
integration.items.0.title: REST API
integration.items.0.text:
• JWT / PAT / OAuth Authentication
• CRUD for employees, groups, shifts, clients
• Configurable scheduling rules
• Manageable qualification catalogue
integration.items.1.title: MCP Endpoint
integration.items.1.text:
• POST /mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless)
• RFC 9728, OAuth 2.1
• Skill-based catalogue (read/write)
• Confirmation flow for write actions
integration.items.2.title: Deployment
integration.items.2.text:
• Docker in just a few minutes
• Own infrastructure, no cloud
• 30 country packages with holiday calendars
integration.items.3.title: Languages
integration.items.3.text:
• 4 core languages (DE/EN/FR/IT)
• 21 plugin language packs
• 25 languages in total
cta.title: Ready?
cta.text: Download Klacks, start Docker, and configure your own industry profile with Klacksy. No registration required.
